These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data. - Cookie seed - Duration 1 minute - Description Technical cookie to ensure session security and form protection. - Cookie PHPSESSID - Duration session - Description This cookie is native to PHP applications. The cookie stores and identifies a user's unique session ID to manage user sessions on the website. The cookie is a session cookie and will be deleted when all the browser windows are closed. - Cookie cookieyes-\* - Duration 1 year - Description CookieYes sets this cookie for consent solution management. Functional Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features. - Cookie dcs - Duration session - Description Set by Feratel media technologies AG to maintain the visitor session state across page requests. Required for the technical function of embedded Feratel webcams and WebTV solutions. - Cookie JSESSIONID - Duration session - Description General session cookie of a Java-based application (Feratel). It maintains the user's session state during the visit and is required for the technical functioning of the embedded Feratel content (e.g. webcams/WebTV). It is deleted when the browser is closed. - Cookie ytidb::LAST\_RESULT\_ENTRY\_KEY - Duration Never Expires - Description Set by YouTube and stores the last entry clicked from the YouTube search results. It is used to show the user more relevant search results in the future. Analytics Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as the number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc. - Cookie \_gid - Duration 1 day - Description Set by Google Analytics to distinguish users. A unique value is stored and updated for each page viewed. The cookie expires after 24 hours. - Cookie gtm\_page\_view - Duration 1 hour - Description This cookie is set via Google Tag Manager and is used to count and deduplicate page views within a short time window (page-view tracking as part of web analytics). - Cookie \_ga\_\* - Duration 1 year 1 month 4 days - Description Google Analytics sets this cookie to store and count page views and user interactions on the website. - Cookie \_ga - Duration 1 year 1 month 4 days - Description Google Analytics sets this cookie to calculate visitor, session and campaign data and track site usage for the site's analytics report. The cookie stores information anonymously and assigns a randomly generated number to recognise unique visitors. Performance Performance cookies are used to understand and analyse the key performance indexes of the website which helps in delivering a better user experience for the visitors. No cookies to display. Advertisement Advertisement cookies are used to provide visitors with customised advertisements based on the pages you visited previously and to analyse the effectiveness of the ad campaigns. - Cookie sp\_t - Cookie \_pin\_unauth - Duration 1 year - Description Pinterest set this cookie to group actions for users who cannot be identified. - Cookie \_fbp - Duration 3 months - Description Facebook sets this cookie to store and track interactions. - It is used to deliver and frequency-cap advertising and to measure and optimize campaigns. - Cookie IDE - Duration 1 year 24 days - Description Google DoubleClick IDE cookies store information about how the user uses the website to present them with relevant ads according to the user profile. If you continue from here with a hike into Bluntautal Valley, this truly is a perfect excursion for the whole family. * * * Golling Waterfall Golling is about 30 km south of Salzburg. In the district of Torren ("torrens" Lat. torrent), the waterfall plunges down 75 metres in two stages. The hiking trail leads almost entirely through forest and is also suitable for children.
